name: Reconstruction Agent
description: Reconstructs incomplete genomes or missing biological information. Covers filling in fragmented, partial or missing sequence data; reconstructing the genome of an extinct or poorly sequenced species; and inferring biological information that no database holds directly. Used when retrieval has already failed or the data is known to be incomplete - not as a first stop for data that can simply be looked up. Works on a specific sequence: the user must paste the nucleotide sequence containing the gaps, or name the accession of the record to repair. It does not pick a target sequence on its own.
